Matched evaluation protocol

Epoch 10 only. LIBERO Spatial, Object, Goal and Long (libero_10): 10 tasks per suite, seeds 42/43/44, official initial states 0–49 per task/seed. This gives 500 episodes per suite/seed, 1500 per suite and 6000 per condition. Python, NumPy, Torch and the environment are seeded once per task/seed group; episodes retain sequential RNG progression. Each policy query uses the same base seed. Episode state is reset, with 30 settling steps using [0,0,0,0,0,0,-1]. The unchanged original Light-WAM episode function drives simulation.

Policy caps are 400 steps for Spatial/Object/Goal and 700 for Long. Predict 32 actions and execute 10 before replanning. Two 256-pixel camera renders rotate 180 degrees, resize with antialiasing to 224 pixels, and concatenate to 448×224. Input proprioception has 8 components; output actions have 7. Normalize using the verified release statistics; gripper mapping preserves the original zero tie. Use FP32 model parameters, BF16 autocast/VAE, native scheduling and native memory updates/reset. Chrono uses 10 denoising steps; ResidualTrans uses its named native schedule, including schedules with fewer denoising steps. Videos remain enabled.

Acceleration retains native model arithmetic. Local graph eligibility requires 15 paired real queries over seeds 42/43/44 with bit-exact actions (and Chrono memory states), followed by native-matching benchmark episode success/length/query signatures. These are finite validation checks. CL-A graphs were excluded after a benchmark mismatch. RT-A S4 originally stopped locally after an eager 4/8-worker mismatch; its subsequent H100 result is separately reported as external_complete, not as a repaired local replay. Benchmark failures are never scored episodes.

Only complete task/seed groups may be resumed; interrupted groups redo episodes 0–49 to preserve RNG progression. Local complete results are independently verified against checkpoint identity, the full task grid, atomic group records and nonempty rollout videos. External H100 results have separately audited CSV grids, identities and statistics; their recorded runner hash differs from the committed export, and original videos are not locally available.

SR and seed standard deviation are percentages. Seed SD is the sample standard deviation of the three seed means (n=3). Overall SR averages the four equally sized suites. H100 runtime is left blank when no comparable wall time was provided.

    "published_revision": "97d55b1cfc097e846dc679c0763e93b0b4ac0183",

    "adapter_ast_equal": true,
    "training_only_diff": "diff --git a/src/fastwam/datasets/chronoloop_data.py b/src/fastwam/datasets/chronoloop_data.py\nindex 273855a..5747687 100644\n--- a/src/fastwam/datasets/chronoloop_data.py\n+++ b/src/fastwam/datasets/chronoloop_data.py\n@@ -254,3 +254,54 @@ def read_latents(cache, indices, device):\n         raise RuntimeError('Latent cache miss; run scripts/chronoloop_precompute_latents.py first')\n     bits = np.ascontiguousarray(cache._latents[ids]).view(np.int16)\n     return torch.from_numpy(bits).view(torch.bfloat16).to(device=device, non_blocking=True).float()\n+\n+\n+def stage_latent_cache(src, dst, threads=8, chunk=256 << 20, timeout=3600):\n+    \"\"\"Copy the latent cache directory to node-local storage (e.g. /dev/shm) once per node.\n+\n+    Random 150 KB reads from Lustre are I/O bound (~5 s per 128 windows); a local copy makes\n+    them memory-speed. Concurrent callers (several runs on one node) coordinate through an\n+    exclusive lock file; others wait for READY. Files are copied with parallel positional I/O\n+    and verified by size; the cache's own metadata check runs when it is opened.\n+    \"\"\"\n+    import os, time\n+    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor\n+    src, dst = Path(src), Path(dst)\n+    dst.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n+    ready, lock = dst / 'READY', dst / '.lock'\n+    names = ('metadata.json', 'valid.uint8', 'latents.uint16')\n+    deadline = time.time() + timeout\n+    while not ready.exists():\n+        try:\n+            fd = os.open(lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY)\n+        except FileExistsError:\n+            if time.time() > deadline:\n+                raise TimeoutError(f'Timed out waiting for latent staging in {dst}')\n+            time.sleep(5)\n+            continue\n+        try:\n+            for name in names:\n+                size = (src / name).stat().st_size\n+                tmp = dst / f'{name}.tmp'\n+                with open(src / name, 'rb') as fi, open(tmp, 'wb') as fo:\n+                    fo.truncate(size)\n+                    a, b = fi.fileno(), fo.fileno()\n+\n+                    def copy(offset):\n+                        n = min(chunk, size - offset)\n+                        while n > 0:\n+                            data = os.pread(a, min(n, 64 << 20), offset)\n+                            if not data:\n+                                raise IOError('short read while staging latents')\n+                            os.pwrite(b, data, offset)\n+                            offset += len(data); n -= len(data)\n+                    with ThreadPoolExecutor(threads) as pool:\n+                        list(pool.map(copy, range(0, size, chunk)))\n+                if tmp.stat().st_size != size:\n+                    raise IOError(f'staged size mismatch for {name}')\n+                tmp.replace(dst / name)\n+            ready.write_text(str(time.time()))\n+        finally:\n+            os.close(fd)\n+            lock.unlink(missing_ok=True)\n+    return dst\n",

Interpretation and verification limits

  • Scored results are read only from final_rollout directories. Benchmark, preflight and failed activation trials are excluded.
  • SR is successes divided by evaluated episodes. An unstarted or cancelled condition has null SR, not zero.
  • Local complete conditions pass strict verification of all 6000 episodes, 120 committed task/seed groups, episode evidence and videos. external_complete conditions are imported H100 reports: exact episode grids, statistics and checkpoint SHAs are audited, while original video artifacts and the recorded runner source snapshot are not locally available. See h100_evidence_audit.json for the runner-hash discrepancy and hardware provenance.
  • Partial rows are a timestamped snapshot and are not directly comparable to complete suite averages.
  • Scored runtime includes model initialization, inference, simulation and video writing. Preflight and speed tuning time is reported separately.
  • Completed historical baseline reports are preserved; Long-only baseline averages cover 1500 episodes, while full-suite averages cover 6000.
